title: SEC4: double if-let on AuthinfoPass looks like bug
description: In lifecycle.rs run_command_loop (~lines 443-490), the AuthinfoPass command is handled with two consecutive if let Command::AuthinfoPass(...) = cmd blocks. The first checks config.auth.required && \!ctx.tls_active and issues 483/continue; the second (if the first did not fire) extracts the password. This pattern looks like a missed else-if or a code duplication mistake. A reader must notice that the first block's continue prevents the second from executing in the rejection case, and that the two if-let bindings are intentionally separate because the first needs a unit match (to check TLS) and the second needs the password value. A single if let with an early return inside, or an explanatory comment, would make the intent obvious.
